name: masareef
description: Masareef: voice-first personal expense tracker (monorepo root)

scripts.openapi:generate: npm run openapi:generate --workspace @masareef/api && npm run generate --workspace @masareef/api-types
scripts.openapi:check: npm run openapi:check --workspace @masareef/api && npm run check --workspace @masareef/api-types
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc --project apps/web/e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.voice:validate: npm run build && npm run validate --workspace @masareef/poc-voice
scripts.voice:score: npm run build && npm run score --workspace @masareef/poc-voice
